title: Inside historical torque spike zone
message: Bit is within the 2432–2599 m interval where offset wells recorded torque spike.

evidence.narrative: Erratic surface torque spikes 18-26 kNm (baseline 12 kNm) and stick-slip while drilling Barail coal stringers; string stalled twice. Depth 2461.8 m MD.
evidence.mitigation: Reduced WOB 20%, increased RPM to 140, added 2% lubricant; worked pipe and back-reamed stand

evidence.narrative: Torque spikes to 29 kNm with overpull 25 t on connection in Barail coal; cavings of blocky coal on shakers. Depth 2556.6 m MD.
evidence.mitigation: Raised mud weight 0.3 ppg for coal stability, pumped hi-vis sweep, back-reamed out of hole to casing shoe
evidence.outcome: Hole cleaned; torque back to normal after wiper trip

recommendation.summary: Reduce WOB by 30%; check top-drive parameters; prepare for string reciprocation

title: Approaching historical mud loss zone
message: 4 m to the 2628–2718 m interval where 1 offset well(s) had mud loss.

evidence.narrative: Lost circulation encountered at 2658.5m in Kopili. Total fluid loss of 27.0 bbl. Pumped 24.0 bbl medium-nut-plug LCM pill at 1550 lpm. Returned to full circulation after 1.6 hrs.
evidence.mitigation: Pumped LCM pill; reduced mud weight; staged cementing squeeze

recommendation.summary: Pre-mix 25 bbl medium-nut-plug LCM pill; prepare lost circulation contingency; monitor pit volume continuously

offset_well_practice.action: Pumped LCM pill; reduced mud weight; staged cementing squeeze

title: Approaching historical kick zone
message: 9 m to the 2634–2792 m interval where 2 offset well(s) had kick.

evidence.narrative: Pit gain of 10 bbls observed at 2663.9m while drilling Kopili. Shut in BOP. SICP=379 psi, SIDPP=190 psi. Killed using Driller's Method in 7.8 hrs.
evidence.mitigation: Shut in BOP; applied Driller's Method; weighted up mud to kill weight

evidence.narrative: Pit gain of 7 bbls observed at 2742.7m while drilling Kopili. Shut in BOP. SICP=540 psi, SIDPP=473 psi. Killed using Driller's Method in 1.9 hrs.
evidence.mitigation: Shut in BOP; applied Driller's Method; weighted up mud to kill weight

recommendation.summary: Verify kill mud on standby; slow ROP through high-PP zones; monitor flow and pit volume

offset_well_practice.action: Shut in BOP; applied Driller's Method; weighted up mud to kill weight
